result:
The decisive mistake was at step 6. The search results returned at step 5 already contained the answer. Result 5, the Facebook transcript of BBC Earth's silliest animal moments, mentions "a bird that can't fly" and says "rock hoppers live up to their name." That points directly to the rockhopper penguin. BirdSpeciesIdentification_Expert only picked out the YouTube link and asked others to watch the video and describe the bird. This ignored the evidence and sent the team into stalled requests for video observations that nobody could supply.
